axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as a Pharmaceutical Contracts Counsel at Axiom Location: United States (remote or flexible on-site/hybrid depending on engagement) We are seeking Pharmaceutical Contracts Counsel to support future client engagements across the life sciences sector. Our clients are seeking attorneys who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and bring broad-based commercial contracting experience within pharmaceutical or biotech organizations. Responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), work orders, and change orders. Support a wide range of business functions by handling diverse contract types, including IT licenses and SaaS subscriptions, event and sponsorship agreements, and material transfer agreements (MTAs). Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on contract terms, risk allocation, and negotiation strategy. Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, IT, Commercial, and Supply Chain teams to support day-to-day contracting needs. Support manufacturing and supply chain-related agreements, including those involving CMOs, CDMOs, and distribution partners, as part of a broader commercial practice. Ensure contracts align with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements within the pharmaceutical industry. Contribute to contract process improvements, including development of templates, playbooks, and scalable workflows. Manage multiple concurrent matters with competing deadlines in a high-volume environment. Qualifications: 4–12+ years of experience in commercial contracting, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences companies. Strong, hands-on experience drafting and negotiating MSAs, SOWs, work orders, and related commercial agreements in a high-volume setting. Demonstrated experience across a variety of agreement types, including IT/software agreements, vendor contracts, event/sponsorship agreements, and MTAs. Ability to operate as a generalist supporting multiple business units, with comfort shifting across different contract types and stakeholders. Familiarity with manufacturing, supply, or distribution agreements is preferred but not required as a primary focus. Proven ability to independently manage a large pipeline of contracts with efficiency and sound judgment. Excellent communication skills, with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach to advising business teams. Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. Preferred Skills: Prior in-house experience within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences company. Experience supporting procurement, IT, and commercial teams in a centralized legal function. Familiarity with regulatory considerations impacting pharma contracts (e.g., FDA, GMP, GxP environments). Exposure to biologics or large-molecule manufacturing and distribution environments. Ability to quickly integrate into new teams and deliver value in dynamic client settings. Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. jobgether-jobgether:lever:11bcd84e-401c-.description: his position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Desktop and Site Support Technician based in Canada. This role is ideal for a hands-on IT professional who enjoys solving technical problems and helping users stay productive. You’ll provide desktop, hardware, software, network, and systems support across an on-site environment in Toronto. The position combines day-to-day troubleshooting with equipment preparation, user onboarding, asset management, and technical maintenance. You’ll support both on-site teams and remote employees, ensuring technology is configured, accessible, and working reliably. The role offers exposure to Windows and macOS, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, remote-support tools, and a broad range of IT hardware. You’ll work closely with other IT professionals while developing your technical capabilities in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. This is a fully on-site opportunity with a fixed Monday-to-Friday schedule and potential emergency support requirements. Provide in-person, phone, and remote technical support to end users, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system issues. Troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, printers, peripherals, mobile devices, and other IT equipment. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows and macOS operating systems and business applications. Perform routine hardware maintenance, repairs, upgrades, replacements, and equipment preparation. Support basic network troubleshooting, including connectivity, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and network-access issues. Prepare and configure desktops, monitors, keyboards, and other equipment for new and existing remote employees, including packaging and shipment coordination. Provide technical onboarding support to new hires, helping users connect to company systems and properly configure their equipment. Educate users on hardware and software best practices to reduce recurring technical issues. Maintain accurate records of support requests, troubleshooting activities, IT assets, and equipment inventory. Collaborate with other IT team members on escalated technical issues, infrastructure initiatives, and broader IT projects. Prioritize and manage multiple support requests effectively while maintaining a strong customer-service experience. Provide emergency technical assistance during major outages or critical incidents when required, with eligible hours potentially compensated through lieu time. Requirements: Current enrollment in a computer-related program, a completed computer-related education, or equivalent professional IT experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+ or Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate are valued. Hands-on experience troubleshooting Windows and macOS operating systems. Familiarity with Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, and remote desktop/support tools. Understanding of basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity troubleshooting. Knowledge of computer hardware components, peripherals, and their functions. Strong problem-solving skills with a methodical, detail-oriented approach. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users. Customer-first mindset with a friendly, patient, and professional approach. Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced support environment. Willingness to learn, adapt, and develop knowledge of new technologies and IT practices. Ability to work fully on-site and remain within reasonable commuting distance of the primary Toronto locations. Benefits: Annual base salary of approximately $45,000 CAD. Fixed Monday-to-Friday schedule with a 9-hour shift, either 8:00 AM–4:00 PM or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. Comprehensive

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9a508335-4146-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager based in Portugal. As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic and technical partner to large enterprise customers throughout their entire journey. You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through long-term adoption, retention, and expansion. The role combines technical expertise, project management, customer success, and consultative problem-solving. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Engineering, and other teams to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value. Your curiosity and ability to understand complex data environments will help customers get the most from a sophisticated technology platform. You will also bring customer feedback and emerging use cases back to internal teams to influence product evolution. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-moving, collaborative, and technology-driven environment. Own the technical customer journey from kickoff and onboarding through ongoing success, adoption, retention, and expansion. Manage and execute customer-facing technical projects, ensuring onboarding activities are well organized, timely, and aligned with customer objectives. Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and develop a deep understanding of their business requirements, technical environments, use cases, and challenges. Provide proactive technical guidance and recommend best practices to help customers maximize the value and adoption of the platform. Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and support the growth of strategic accounts. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Translate customer requirements into practical, efficient solutions while helping customers navigate complex technical systems. Identify emerging customer use cases, recurring challenges, and product opportunities, and communicate these insights to Engineering and other product teams. Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance technical depth with business priorities and customer outcomes. Manage competing priorities, deadlines, and unexpected roadblocks while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in a client-facing and/or technology-focused role combining strong business understanding with technical expertise. Demonstrated experience managing and delivering technical projects with a customer-first mindset and strong empathy for customer needs. Excellent project management, organization, written communication, and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments, including SQL, databases, APIs, reporting tools, and related systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a genuine interest in continuously developing technical expertise. Ability to understand customer requirements at a detailed level and translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds and responsibilities. Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure, manage deadlines, and navigate unexpected challenges with confidence. A customer-oriented, curious, proactive, and consultative approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Willingness and ability to work in a fast-paced technology environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Benefits: Competitive compensation package. Meaningful equity compensation through ISO options. Early exercise opportunities for eligible equity. 10-year post-termination exercise window for equity

southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:4b784e01.description: ABOUT ROX Rox https://www.rox.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com is building the AI-native revenue operating system. Most enterprise software was built for humans operating dashboards. Rox is built for agents operating systems. Instead of static workflows, Rox runs continuous decision loops powered by real-time context from across the enterprise. Agents analyze signals, reason about them, and take action — automatically. To make that possible, we are building infrastructure that combines elements of: - distributed systems - real-time decisioning - agent execution frameworks - semantic retrieval systems - low-latency streaming infrastructure - knowledge graph architectures We’re backed by Sequoia, GV, and General Catalyst and have grown rapidly from 15 to 75 people while shipping our platform years faster than the market expected. We already support Global 2000 customers across industries including banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI. We are building for what enterprise AI systems will require two years from now — not just what exists today. ABOUT THE CORE ENGINEERING TEAM Core Engineering builds the systems that make autonomous revenue agents reliable at enterprise scale. This team sits at the center of Rox’s long-term technical strategy and owns foundational infrastructure across: - agent reliability and orchestration - distributed execution systems - graph-based retrieval infrastructure - streaming and real-time context systems - observability for autonomous workflows - low-latency data and inference pipelines The problems here look less like traditional SaaS application engineering and more like: - real-time OLAP systems - streaming compute platforms - distributed databases - semantic retrieval systems - deterministic execution infrastructure - high-scale platform engineering At Rox, agents continuously: - retrieve context - reason across changing state - trigger actions - update workflows - coordinate across systems Core Engineering builds the infrastructure that makes those loops fast, reliable, observable, and deterministic. THE ROLE We are hiring a Core Engineer to help design and operate the foundational infrastructure behind Rox’s autonomous agent platform. This role is ideal for engineers who have deep systems intuition and want to work on infrastructure problems at the frontier of AI reliability. You might be a fit if you’ve spent time building: - distributed infrastructure - streaming systems - semantic search infrastructure - graph-based retrieval systems - execution runtimes - reliability infrastructure - low-latency backend platforms Or if you’ve historically been “the person” inside your company for difficult infrastructure problems. We care deeply about engineering craftsmanship, systems thinking, and people who can reason about long-term architecture under real-world scale constraints. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build infrastructure for reliable autonomous agent execution - Design systems for deterministic, auditable agent behavior at enterprise SLAs - Develop low-latency retrieval and context systems powering AI workflows - Build and scale graph-based infrastructure and semantic retrieval systems - Improve observability, debugging, and reliability across distributed agent systems - Work on real-time data ingestion and streaming architectures - Collaborate closely with platform, AI, and product engineering teams - Help shape the long-term architecture behind Rox’s agent runtime PROBLEMS YOU’LL WORK ON - Reliability for long-horizon AI workflows - Agent orchestration across distributed systems - Deterministic execution for autonomous systems - Streaming context ingestion and retrieval - Knowledge graph infrastructure - Real-time state synchronization - Low-latency execution pipelines - Enterprise-grade observability for agent systems MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS - Strong background in distributed systems or platform engineering - Experience building and operating high-scale backend infrastructure - Strong systems fun
